prediction.liveProbabilityRule: Use the frozen calibrated probability only; do not retrain or shift thresholds from results.

oneBetPerRace.ranking: Highest stressed calibrated model EV; tie-break lower odds, then higher original raw model EV.

raceDayCap.ranking: If more than three races qualify on one HK race day, keep the three highest stressed calibrated model EV selections.
raceDayCap.note: A same-day loss-stop overlay was tested and did not improve reused-audit robustness, so it is not included.

staking.rule: No Kelly, no edge-tier stake increases, no chase sizing. Dollar stake remains unset until capacity and bankroll risk are separately approved.

liveExecution.note: A historical possibility is cancelled if the actual executable quote no longer clears the frozen +4% calibrated EV gate.

historicalHeadline.note: Dollar figures scale linearly from a A$1,000 research unit and are not a recommended live stake.

fixedSelectionPriceStress.note: Price-stress tests keep the originally selected bets fixed; they do not reselect a friendlier subset.

winnerConcentration.warning: Historical realized profit is materially concentrated in a small number of high-odds winners. This is a major reason the system remains shadow despite positive model EV.

riskDiagnostics.regimeWarning: The 2021-2023 rolling three-year realized period was weak even while calibrated model ROI stayed positive. Do not size from historical realized ROI alone.

postExecutionAccounting.rule: Only the actually accepted stake and price count. Rejected, partial or stale quotes do not count as executed bets.
